items.title: BBC's Kate Phillips On AI, YouTube & 'Blue Planet III'
items.excerpt: At MIPCOM the BBC's content chief said the broadcaster would never 'lie to the audience' about AI use in its productions, days after the DG said he'd been sent a 'pretty good' AI-generated Doctor Who episode.

items.title: Hollywood Animation Directors On Distribution, Sequels, And AI
items.excerpt: At View Conference, the directors of 'GOAT,' 'Forgotten Island' and 'Toy Story 5' discussed the box office, original storytelling and, unavoidably, where generative AI fits in animation production.

items.title: Adobe and NVIDIA Expand Collaboration to Further Optimize Agentic Creation With Its Flagship Tools
items.excerpt: Adobe and NVIDIA are adding optimizations for agentic creation across Photoshop, Premiere, Substance 3D and more, aimed at running AI editing workflows locally on RTX Spark machines.

items.title: Give your stories more ways to take shape with Canvas in Flow Studio
items.excerpt: Autodesk Flow Studio's new Canvas gives filmmakers access to leading generative models to create and refine characters, worlds and shots alongside its 3D Editor (sponsored post from Autodesk).

items.title: Stem Separation Moves Into the Edit: What Enhance Audio Changes for Dialogue Workflows in Premiere (Beta)
items.excerpt: Premiere's beta Enhance Audio now separates dialogue, music and ambience stems inside the timeline, so editors can fix uneven lav/boom tracks and baked-in music without a round trip to audio post.

items.title: A Freshman Year Foundation for AI Filmmaking
items.excerpt: Kevin Geiger argues that in the generative AI era, traditional first-year creative principles matter more than ever for people learning to make films with AI tools. (Date from AWN RSS; site 403s to fetchers.)

items.title: Open to AI: Hollywood Is Embracing Artificial Intelligence Tools Despite Doomsday Fears
items.excerpt: A Variety feature on how studios, directors and productions are quietly folding AI tools into their pipelines despite public fears about the technology.

items.title: Tsui Hark Pays Emotional Tribute to Nansun Shi, Discusses New Projects and Reflects on AI at Lumière Festival
items.excerpt: At Lumière, Tsui Hark talked about new projects, including a dreamlike future city, and the growing challenges filmmakers face in the age of AI.

items.title: Canon, Nikon, Sony, and FUJIFILM on the Future of Cameras – Video, Shared Platforms and AI
items.excerpt: Executives from the four big camera makers lay out where cameras are headed: video-first design, shared platforms and AI in the shooting experience.

items.title: OpenAI's shelved Sora may return as AI for filmmakers
items.excerpt: Citing The Information, OpenAI is negotiating to transfer its discontinued Sora video model to a months-old startup that builds AI video tools for filmmakers and plans to keep improving Sora. (Off-list: no on-list outlet carried it.)

items.title: 촬영부터 더빙까지 책상머리서 뚝딱…게임하듯 영화 찍는 시대
items.excerpt: TapNow's 'Arena Peak Asia' Seoul round had teams make 3–8 minute AI films in 32 hours, using the platform for at least 80% of production from shooting to dubbing. (Off-list Korean.)

items.title: AI로 10억도 안 써 뚝딱 만든 '스틸레이' 영화 흥행할까
items.excerpt: Korean SF action feature 'Steelray', made with AI in six months for under 1 billion won, opens in theaters Oct 21. (Off-list Korean.)

items.title: [극장가] 롯데시네마서 AI 영화 3천원…87개국 출품작 엄선
items.excerpt: Lotte Cinema is giving 18 finalist AI films from the 2026 K-AICA awards, picked from entries from 87 countries, an exclusive theatrical run at 3,000 won a ticket. (Off-list Korean.)

items.title: 기간도 제작비도 절반, AI가 바꾸는 영화판
items.excerpt: At BIFF's Inno Asia WIP showcase, 12 AI-built features, series and animations were shown for the first time, pointing to roughly half the schedule and budget. (Off-list Korean.)
